integrity: The proof combines the published lower bound with an exact finite recursion. Every recursive branch has a proved monotone upper bound, the final component is solved algebraically, and the packaged verifier uses exact rational arithmetic. The 1975 source records presentation on 1975-01-25. Its old primary classification 10A20 is the arithmetic-functions subject now represented by MSC2020 11A25 in modern harmonic-number literature.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the least unitary harmonic mean and all minimizers only for integers with exactly five distinct prime factors. It does not classify the entire five-prime-support family or determine the next attainable mean.
title: Least unitary harmonic mean at five-prime support
